name: hour
description: Timestamp with hour resolution. This row applies starting from `hour` till `hour` plus sixty minutes.

name: dt
description: How much the satellite clock is offset (in seconds)from the consensus (median) of all satellite clocks.

name: pings
description: Number of pings used in computing the clock offset. Lower values mean the result is likely to be less reliable.

name: avg_distance_from_sat_km
description: Average distance of vessels from the satellite during a given hour. Anomalously large values are another way to infer that the satellite clocks are off, however this has been superseded by the dt field.

name: med_dist_from_sat_km
description: Median distance of vessels from the satellite during a given hour. Anomalously large values are another way to infer that the satellite clocks are off, however this has been superseded by the dt field.
